meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 为 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类调用注册 PostToolUse 钩子。若 comment-checker 在补丁后报出警告,Codex 会收到阻塞性反馈,需先修正或说明被标记的注释再继续。
howto.when: 在 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类操作成功执行后,comment-checker 报出警告时触发;非编辑类工具不触发。

say.text: 解释一下 comment-checker 刚标记的那条注释
say.note: Codex 会先说明被标记的注释再继续

say.text: 把 comment-checker 警告的那条注释改掉
say.note: 它会修正被标记的注释

say.text: comment-checker 这个警告能忽略吗,说明理由
say.note: 它会给出解释或修正后再继续

howto.what_en: Registers a PostToolUse hook for successful apply_patch, write, edit and similar calls. When comment-checker warns after a patch, Codex gets blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggers after a successful edit-like call (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.) when comment-checker emits a warning; non-edit tools are ignored.

say_en.text: Explain the comment comment-checker just flagged.
say_en.note: Codex explains the flagged comment before continuing

say_en.text: Fix the comment comment-checker warned about.
Can I ignore this comment-checker warning? Explain.
say_en.note: It explains or fixes, then continues
